mentions.name: Onida
mentions.description: A vision-language model architecture designed to match or surpass the performance of leading VLMs like LLaVA and CogVLM while operating at a fraction of the cost. Unlike most existing VLMs that layer vision components onto a language model as an afterthought, Onida is built from first principles with a truly integrated vision-language design. It is currently inviting beta participants to explore and test the technology.
mentions.problem: Most existing VLMs bolt vision components onto language models as an afterthought, and leading models are costly to run; Onida aims to deliver comparable or better performance at a fraction of the cost.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m working on a new vision-language model architecture called Onida. Our aim is to match—or surpass—the performance of leading VLMs like LLavA and CogVLM, while operating at a fraction of the cost.
